Load nfl player data regular season data from 2025 (RB, TE, WR)

```{r,message=F,warning=F}
library(nflreadr)
library(tidyverse)
fantasy2025 <- load_player_stats(2025, summary_level = "reg") |>
  dplyr::filter(position %in% c("TE","WR","RB")) |>
  select(player_display_name,position,games,
         carries,rushing_yards,rushing_tds,
         receptions,targets,receiving_yards,receiving_tds,
         fantasy_points_ppr)
glimpse(fantasy2025)
```
